results.title: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.
results.original_title: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.
results.overview: In a special one off concert in Manchester, recorded on the evening of March 6, Harry Styles played his new album, ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.' for the very first time.

results.title: Dan Bandung
results.overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

results.title: Shark Lake
results.overview: A couple travel to a remote hotel hoping to repair their relationship, only to discover that the mysterious owner is hiding a deadly secret involving his hungry pet shark, Cinnamon.

results.title: Doris
results.overview: Based on William Demby's 1965 novel The Catacombs.

results.title: Karateka
results.overview: At 39, Spanish karateka Sandra Sánchez sets her sights on Olympic gold in Tokyo, pushing her career toward its defining test. Her coach and life partner, Jesús del Moral, remains beside her throughout, a bond that turns each step toward the Games into a shared act of commitment.

results.title: No Rest for the Wicked
results.overview: 1862. Baldur lives a fisherman’s life on the isolated Faroe Islands far to the north in the Atlantic Ocean. His world is turned upside down when a stranger arrives: Helge, a rugged whaler, who awakens deep emotions within him. A mutual attraction starts to grow. When tragedy strikes, their forbidden passion unleashes natural forces so disturbing that the villagers rally to keep evil at bay. But Baldur and Helge refuse to let their love be buried. They will fight till the end – and after.

results.title: Apophenia
results.overview: When a conspiracy shakes a small corporation, it’s up to one employee to discover the truth.

results.title: Stalling
results.overview: Minutes before a job interview, a man with a stubborn case of shy bladder becomes the center of an increasingly surreal restroom spectacle as every well-intention attempt to help only makes things worse.

results.title: Redline Fury
results.overview: Street racers go against bad guy. Bad guy gets very angry. Bad guy gets back at good guys. Good guys win against bad guy. Movie has all the G's - Guts, Gears, Guns, and Girls. Good.

results.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
results.overview: An outspoken psychologist, burnt by love, takes an emergency trip to Los Angeles with her best friend to talk her smitten daughter out of marrying a man she is convinced is a narcissist.

results.title: Barbara Forever
results.overview: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

results.title: My 2007
results.overview: For her birthday, Kira, a grey blur, tries to break free from the drabness of her provincial town and fit in with a group of trendy outsiders However, a series of sudden events and painful revelations force her to reconsider her values.

results.title: Badland Rising
results.overview: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

results.title: Shame and Money
results.overview: After losing their livelihood in a village, a Kosovar family is forced to move to the capital in pursuit of a place in a hypercapitalist society.

results.title: Ultimate Revenge
results.overview: The Yau Tsim Mong area, the core commercial area of Hong Kong, has recently experienced a series of robberies. Many jewelry stores in the area have been ransacked by gangsters. Police unit is given the mission to take the gangsters into a custody, but the operation is not so easy.

results.title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2026: Chicago
results.overview: The 2026 Worlds Collide, also promoted as Worlds Collide: Chicago, was a professional wrestling live event co-produced by WWE and its sister promotion AAA. It was the sixth Worlds Collide under the WWE banner and the third between both promotions. It was filmed on September 26, 2026, at Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, USA, but aired on September 30.

results.title: Thaai Kizhavi
results.overview: An elderly and feared moneylender from a village near Madurai falls seriously ill, prompting her estranged sons and extended family to reunite after years of separation. As tensions rise inside the household, hidden motives, family conflicts, and expectations over her wealth turn her uncertain condition into the center of a chaotic family drama.

results.title: Miss You, Love You
results.overview: Forced to plan her late husband's funeral with her estranged gay son's assistant, a blunt, grieving widow forms an unlikely bond with the total stranger as confronting their shared grief surfaces deep family secrets and long-held resentments.

results.title: Toy
results.overview: After losing her father, lonely 15-year-old Brody finds comfort in an old dinosaur toy she discovers at a yard sale. But when pets and bullies start disappearing, she realizes her new friend has a hunger for more than just companionship. Now, Brody must make a choice--stop the carnage or embrace the only friend who truly understands her pain.
